title: Anthropic to watermark all Claude-generated text to meet EU code
summary: Anthropic said models released after Aug 2 will watermark text and files (C2PA), joining Google, Meta, Microsoft and OpenAI under the EU AI Act Transparency Code.
reason: Frontier lab compliance with EU rules.

title: French publishers ask competition watchdog to act on Google AI summaries
summary: A French press group said Google's AI summaries cut publisher traffic by 33-38% without consent or pay and sought antitrust action.
reason: Antitrust pressure on a dominant AI platform; complaint only.
